title: 第15章 挂2随身携带渡劫修士的小师弟第16章 总感觉她带坏了一个好孩子
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 在原剧情中，祁翎羽是一个很惨的人，他出生在下界一个大家族中，其他孩子早早就觉醒修仙灵根，唯独祁翎羽不论怎么尝试都觉醒不了。
那个大家族里的人就认为祁翎羽是一个天生不能修仙之人，对他各种嘲讽挖苦。
祁翎羽也曾自暴自弃过，他埋怨老天不公，凭什么所有人都能修仙就他不能。
直至后来，祁翎羽无意间来到后山，看到一块被扔在山脚下的玉牌。
好奇心驱使下，祁翎羽将玉牌捡起。
至此，一个天才诞生了。
玉牌中藏着一位渡劫修士的灵魂！
那名渡劫修士一眼看出祁翎羽天生异骨，之所以不能修炼，是因为他天赋实在太强！
一旦祁翎羽踏入修真界，整个修真界都会因他的出现而发生改变，再天才的天才在祁翎羽面前都不值得一提，都会被他踩在脚下，老天不许这样的天才存在，这才不给他灵力让他修炼。
渡劫修士跟祁翎羽做了一个交易，他帮助祁翎羽修仙，而祁翎羽养他的灵魂，让他不要太快灵魂湮灭。
祁翎羽答应了，渡劫修士的灵魂附在祁翎羽身上，并教给祁翎羽一本名为《九天造化诀》的功法。
只要祁翎羽将这造化诀第一层练透，并且拥有一枚四品阴阳逆转丹，再加上一点千年百草露，就可以成功逆天改命踏入修仙界的大门。
祁翎羽花费了三年时间将《九天造化诀》第一层练完，但去哪里找四品丹药和千年百草露呢？
女主洛云卿出场了，这个时间段洛云卿已经成功勾搭上了好几个男人，但一次偶然的相遇，她还是对这个意气风发的红衣少年一见钟情了。
为了得到祁翎羽，洛云卿可是花尽了心思。
四品丹药只有高级炼丹师可以炼制，洛云卿只认识一个高级炼丹师，那就是大道无上宗的首席弟子商时序。
洛云卿跑去大道无上宗去哀求商时序给祁翎羽炼丹，商时序本就对洛云卿有异样心思，洛云卿求着求着就在大道无上宗和商时序滚在了一起。
丹药搞定了，接下来就是千年百草露。
洛云卿一直觉得祁翎羽对她没有别的心思，怕最后竹篮打水一场空，她想了一招。
洛云卿打探到千年百草露的消息后并没有第一时间拿给祁翎羽，而是在其中偷偷加入了无色无味的情药。
祁翎羽吞下百草露后瞬间火烧全身，理智全无，洛云卿心满意足的和祁翎羽发生了关系。
至此，洛云卿后宫再多一位成员。
回忆完祁翎羽的剧情，林筱满脑子只剩下一件事，那可是渡劫修士，渡劫修士！
她记得天衍宗宗主也是渡劫修士来着。
尼玛，这等于她那小师弟随身把天衍宗宗主带身上啊。
祁翎羽天赋极高，原着中写他从练气到筑基就用了十天。
一天一重，十天筑基。
这谁能比得过？
这才是他妈的妥妥开挂啊！
哎，等等。
如果她没记错，她那个小师弟现在还没修炼完那本《九天造化诀吧》，系统现在选定了他，那他十天筑基，她是不是也能跟着提升……足足三又三分之一级！
修炼，恐怖如斯。
但她喜欢。
林筱现在就想去看看她这个妖孽的小师弟，然后用小鞭鞭在后面抽他，让他疯狂给她修炼！
不，她想要用小鞭鞭抽所有被系统选定的人，把他们当牛马，一天二十四小时给她修炼。
休息？不存在的。
卷！
都给她卷起来！
林筱想到日后自己修为飞升的画面，忍不住桀桀桀偷笑起来。
这可吓坏了后面抄书的弟子。
content_en:
In the original plot, Qi Lingyu was a very miserable person. He was born in a big family in the lower world. The other children had awakened their spiritual roots to cultivate immortality early, but Qi Lingyu could not awaken no matter how hard he tried.
People in that big family thought that Qi Lingyu was a person who was born unable to cultivate immortality, and ridiculed him in various ways.
Qi Lingyu also gave up on himself. He complained that God was unfair, why everyone could cultivate immortality but he couldn't.
Until later, Qi Lingyu accidentally came to the back mountain and saw a jade tablet thrown at the foot of the mountain.
Driven by curiosity, Qi Lingyu picked up the jade plaque.
At this point, a genius was born.
The jade tablet contains the soul of a monk who has overcome the tribulation!
The tribulation-transcending monk saw at a glance that Qi Lingyu was born with strange bones. The reason why he couldn't practice was because his talent was too strong!
Once Qi Lingyu steps into the world of cultivation, the entire world of cultivation will change due to his appearance. No matter how talented a genius is, they are not worth mentioning in front of Qi Lingyu and will be stepped on by him. God does not allow such a genius to exist, so he does not give him spiritual power to practice.
The tribulation monk made a deal with Qi Lingyu. He helped Qi Lingyu cultivate to immortality, and Qi Lingyu nourished his soul to prevent it from being annihilated too quickly.
Qi Lingyu agreed, and the soul of the monk who transcended the tribulation possessed Qi Lingyu, and taught Qi Lingyu a book called "Nine Heavens Creation Technique".
As long as Qi Lingyu masters the first level of the Creation Technique, possesses a fourth-grade Yin-Yang Reversal Pill, and adds a little Thousand-Year Herb Dew, he can successfully change his fate and step into the world of immortality.
Qi Lingyu spent three years to complete the first level of "Nine Heavens Creation Technique", but where can he find the fourth-grade elixir and the thousand-year-old herb dew?
The heroine Luo Yunqing appears. During this time, Luo Yunqing has successfully hooked up with several men, but after a chance encounter, she fell in love at first sight with this high-spirited young man in red.
In order to get Qi Lingyu, Luo Yunqing spent all his efforts.
Only senior alchemists can refine fourth-grade elixirs. Luo Yunqing only knew one senior alchemist, and that was Shang Shixu, the chief disciple of the Supreme Dao Sect.
Luo Yunqing went to the Supreme Dao Sect to beg Shang Shixu to make elixirs for Qi Lingyu. Shang Shixu had a strange feeling for Luo Yunqing, so Luo Yunqing begged and begged, so he and Shang Shixu got together in the Supreme Dao Sect.
Now that the elixir is done, the next step is the Millennium Herb Dew.
Luo Yunqing always felt that Qi Lingyu had no other thoughts about her, and fearing that the attempt would be in vain, she thought of a move.
After Luo Yunqing found out the news about Thousand-year-old Baicao Dew, he did not give it to Qi Lingyu immediately, but secretly added a colorless and odorless love potion to it.
After Qi Lingyu swallowed Baicao Dew, his whole body was instantly on fire and he lost all reason. Luo Yunqing was satisfied and had sex with Qi Lingyu.
So far, Luo Yunqing has one more member in his harem.
After recalling Qi Lingyu's plot, Lin Xiao only had one thing left in his mind, and that was the Tribulation Overcoming Monk, the Tribulation Overcoming Monk!
She remembered that the leader of the Tianyan Sect was also a tribulation cultivator.
Damn it, this is like her little junior brother is taking the leader of the Tianyan Sect with him.
Qi Lingyu is extremely talented. According to the original work, it took him ten days from Qi training to foundation building.
One layer a day, ten days to build the foundation.
Who can compare to this?
This is fucking cheating!
Hey, wait.
If she remembers correctly, her younger junior brother has not yet finished practicing the "Nine Heavens Creation Art", and the system has selected him now. Then, if he builds the foundation in ten days, will she be able to follow suit and rise... to a full three and one-third levels!
Hiss——
Cultivation is so terrifying.
But she likes it.
Lin Xiao now wanted to see her evil little junior brother, then whip him from behind with a small whip and make him practice for her like crazy!
No, she wants to use a small whip to whip all the people selected by the system, treat them like cattle and horses, and train them for her twenty-four hours a day.
rest? Doesn't exist.
roll!
Roll them all up for her!
Lin Xiao couldn't help but snicker when she thought about how her cultivation level would soar in the future.
This frightened the disciples who copied the book behind.
title_en: Chapter 15 Hang 2 The little junior brother who carries the tribulation monk with him Chapter 16 I always feel that she has led a good child to bad things
